narratives.body: Athlon Sports reports that Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott announced personal news following the team's fourth loss. The headline indicates the announcement came after a difficult period for the franchise.
narratives.headline: Dak Prescott Announces Personal News After 4th Loss

narratives.body: MARCA states that Dak Prescott faces backlash after the Cowboys posted a 0-2 record since he reportedly told C.J. Stroud to 'go get some wins'. The article links the team's recent struggles to this interaction.
narratives.headline: Dak Prescott Faces Backlash After Cowboys 0-2 Record

narratives.body: ESPN and NFL.com note that Dak Prescott's rest-of-season rankings have declined, with headlines indicating he has hit a season low while other players rise. The reports suggest a shift in his standing relative to peers.
narratives.headline: Dak Prescott Rankings Decline Amid Season Low
